rootCause: PluginRuntime.activatePlugin throws a frozen PluginRuntimeErrorRecord, not an Error. The manager previously rethrew it unchanged; main getErrorMessage applied String(record).
minimalFix: Only catalog activation failures at the manager boundary: matching own data fields pluginId=current id, phase=enable, message:string become Error with original record in cause. Existing Error and unknown values unchanged. No main/global error or public SDK changes.
limitations: The original Error stack was already discarded by runtime.recordError; retaining the record as cause does not recover that stack.
